question: The seventh decile (D₇) of data set 4, 3, 7, 10, 9, 1 is
solution:
The correct answer is** 8.8**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A** decile** is a **statistical measure** that divides the data into 10 equal parts.
 
• The **seventh decile (D7)** is the value that separates the first six parts (60% of the data) from the last four parts (40% of the data).
 
• To calculate the decile, the data must be sorted in ascending or descending order, and then the decile value can be found by taking the average of the two closest values that correspond to the desired decile.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Deciles are commonly used to describe the distribution of data and to identify specific points or values in the data set.
 
• There are nine deciles in total: D1, D2, D3, D4, D5, D6, D7, D8, D9, and D10.
 
• D1 is the first decile, and it separates the lowest 10% of the data from the rest.
 
• D10 is the last decile, and it separates the highest 10% of the data from the rest.
 
• Deciles can also be used to calculate other summary statistics, such as percentiles and quartiles.
